description: This PHP class 'FieldFactory' implements a flyweight factory pattern for creating cron field objects based on position indices. It manages instantiation and caching of different cron component classes relevant to scheduling expressions, such as minutes, hours, days, etc.

classes.name: FieldFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and caching instances of cron field objects based on position index.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns an instance of a cron field object for the specified position, creating and caching it if necessary.
